recent_en: Inta Bina declared a third interim dividend of 0.75 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 10 December. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with quarterly revenue of RM229.24 million. Directors and substantial shareholders filed multiple notices of dealings during the closed period in mid-to-late November.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 0.75 sen per share for FY2026.
Released quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Directors and substantial shareholders conducted share dealings during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM180.51 million, down 12.2% QoQ and 3.0% YoY; net income was RM10.36 million, down 4.2% QoQ but up 7.2% YoY; net margin was 5.7%, higher than 5.3% in the previous quarter.
